snippet.title: Scrabdackle Act 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
Scrabdackle Act 1 is coming later this year! Wishlist on Steam, and try the demo! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578720/Scrabdackle/

Scrabdackle is hand-drawn using traditional animation techniques, with tons of curious creatures to study, characters to squabble with, and tough-but-fair bosses to overcome, made by one developer (that's me writing this!) who was maybe a little over-ambitious about things.

Here’s the setup: When the wizard academy is attacked, novice student Blue is thrown out the academy’s window and face-first into the unfamiliar world outside. Pushed out of their sheltered life, Blue reluctantly sets off on a long journey home, learning to navigate the world of Scrabdackle for the first time. Along the way, they’ll contend with daunting foes as well as uncomfortable truths as they reckon with just how much of the world outside differs from their books in the academy.

It’s a big game with a huge, sprawling world worth getting lost in - if you’re up for a bit of adventure! (about 12-15 hours for a first blind playthrough, maybe 18-19 for completion, and the nonlinear approach gives it longer legs if you want to try approaching things in a different order on a second run!)

Join the Discord community, if you want! https://discord.gg/bUY6HP8
Check out the seasonal devlogs! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jakefriend/scrabdackle/posts

All music is original by jakefriend (me!)
